contract: solve(problem, time_limit) -> x: a length-problem['n'] vector for the instance dict (kind, form in {qp, qcqp, socp, lp, milp}, arrays Q, p, A, b, G, h, lb, ub, and H/g/r, cones, c, A_ub, b_ub, A_eq, b_eq, integer as applicable; nonconvex instances add sum(sin(x)), nonsmooth ones add 0.5*||x||_1 to the objective). l2o.objective(problem, x), l2o.violation(problem, x) and l2o.scipy_constraints(problem) are available. Score: mean over five seeded instances of the relative optimality gap against an independent reference (Clarabel / HiGHS / multistart SLSQP); infeasible (violation > 1e-4), non-finite or over-time solutions count as gap 1. Lower is better.
notes: Local instances of the fsnet qp family stand in for the paper's fsnet convex qp dataset.

Local instances in the mathematical form of the paper's families (DC3 and FSNet QP/QCQP/SOCP, IPM-MPNN/PDHG-Net/pivot/basis LP families, predict-and-search and backdoor-branching MILPs) with reduced sizes; the paper's datasets, learned models and CPLEX are not used. References: cvxpy with Clarabel for convex problems, HiGHS for LP/MILP, best-of-8 SLSQP starts for nonconvex problems (best found, not proven optimal).
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
